analysis.overall: You maintained an 80% time-in-range today, though managing morning breakfast caused a sharp spike followed by a steady climb into the 200s before eventually coming back down.

events.title: Afternoon meal and gradual rise
events.description: An initial meal bolus at 2:19 PM was followed by another carb entry and multiple corrections as glucose slowly crept up past 200 mg/dL over the next couple of hours.

events.title: Stable evening transition
events.description: After coming down from the afternoon high, a 25g carb meal was well-managed, keeping numbers steady and near the target range through the evening.

events.title: Morning sandwich spike
events.description: A cheese veg sandwich breakfast led to a sharp double-up trend and a climb up to nearly 210 mg/dL, requiring several correction boluses to bring back down.

events.title: Post-correction descent
events.description: Following the morning high and subsequent correction stack, glucose dipped down near 71 mg/dL before stabilizing nicely with the help of automated basal adjustments.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on morning pre-bolus timing for carb-heavy breakfasts to help blunt that sharp initial rise.
